hi: हेलो, मुझे एक फ्लाइट बुकिंग करनी थी, नहीं, अपने लिए नहीं, फैमिली के लिए।
literal: Hello, I had to make a flight booking, no, not for myself, for family.
fluent: Hello, I need to book a flight, not for me but for my family.

hi: मेरे भाई रोहित और उनकी वाइफ प्रिया के लिए।
literal: For my brother Rohit and his wife Priya.
fluent: It's for my brother Rohit and his wife Priya.

hi: उनको पंद्रह अगस्त को देल्ही से जयपुर जाना है।
literal: They have to go on fifteen August from Delhi to Jaipur.
fluent: They need to fly from Delhi to Jaipur on 15 August.

hi: इंडिगो की फ्लाइट हो तो बेटर है, उनका एक्सपीरियंस तो अच्छा ही रहता है।
literal: If it's an IndiGo flight that's better, their experience is always good.
fluent: IndiGo would be better; they've always had a good experience with it.

hi: टाइमिंग साढ़े दस बजे के आसपास हो, सुबह बहुत जल्दी वाली नहीं चाहिए।
literal: Timing should be around half past ten, a very early morning one is not needed.
fluent: Around 10:30 would be ideal, not a very early morning flight.

hi: पेमेंट मैं अपने आईफ़ोन से यूपीआई से करूँगा।
literal: Payment I will do from my iPhone through UPI.
fluent: I'll pay by UPI from my iPhone.

hi: और टिकट की कॉपी रोहित के मेल पे भी भेज देना।
literal: And send a copy of the ticket to Rohit's mail too.
fluent: And please email a copy of the ticket to Rohit as well.
